unmatched_A.what_changed: Tell-tale indicating failure made mandatory where the component regulation requires it (stop, position, end-outline, DRL lamps)
Tell-tale indicating failure made mandatory where the component regulation requires it (stop, position, end-outline, DRL lamps)
Tell-tale indicating failure made mandatory where the component regulation requires it (stop, position, end-outline, DRL lamps)
Dipped-beam headlamps shall switch ON/OFF automatically relative to ambient light per Annex 13 (alternatives deleted); position-lamp/DRL switching rules
Bend lighting by beam movement may be activated only in forward motion; external status indicator allowed

Failure tell-tale requirements revised (dipped-beam LED module failure, bend lighting; failure tell-tales for reversing, stop, rear fog, parking, side-marker lamps if required by component regulation)

Failure tell-tale requirements revised (dipped-beam LED module failure, bend lighting, other lamps); bend lighting only in forward motion; additional lamps switched ON when hidden by movable components
Failure tell-tale requirements revised (dipped-beam LED module failure, bend lighting, other lamps); bend lighting only in forward motion
Direction-indicator operating tell-tale activation signal sources revised; rear position lamps no longer required ON with DRL
Direction-indicator operating tell-tale activation signal sources revised; position-lamp/DRL switching logic
Direction-indicator operating tell-tale activation signal sources revised; rear position lamps with DRL may be OFF above 7,000 lux ambient
Sequential activation of direction indicators (categories 1-2b, 11-12): uniform inboard-to-outboard progression, single uninterrupted signal, gap limits
Failure of multi-source lamps restructured: failure-signal option per lamp function; DRL, direction indicators, plate lamps and L-category stop/position lamps given specific failure rules
DRL failure of one light source: at least 80% of minimum intensity, or 50% on axis with failure tell-tale required on vehicle
01 series: change index raised for most lamp functions; failure provisions extended (direction indicators incl. L-category categories 11-12); revised light distribution requirements
Lamp shall provide a failure signal if a light source and/or LED module has failed (para. 4.13), for the R48 failure tell-tale
Failure behaviour of mechanical/electromechanical and AFS structures restated (automatic safe passing-beam state); system safety analysis (FMEA/FTA) documentation for AFS control

AFS failure behaviour: on failure the system shall automatically obtain a passing beam or a safe photometric state (switch-off, dimming, aiming down, functional substitution); same for category 1 bending-mode failures

Delegated act updating Annexes I/II: UN R48 07 series (emergency stop signal, revised automatic switching logic) becomes the referenced series; R148/R149/R150 added; D16 emergency stop signal row re-referenced to R48
Implementing act on ADS of fully automated vehicles: ADS shall automatically generate signals to activate/deactivate hazard warning lights and direction indicators per traffic rules

Amends Annex IV of 661/2009: UN R48 row updated to Supplement 10 to the 06 series (automatic dipped-beam switching relative to ambient light per Annex 13), R123 AFS row to 01 series Supp 9, R119 row; compulsory for EU type-approval
Transitional provisions for the 07 series: SBR exemptions for removable rear seats and rows with suspension seats until 2022-09-01; acceptance dates
Second-level SBR warning redefined: activated when vehicle operated per 8.4.2.4.1 and a belt is or becomes unfastened, depending on seating-position requirement

Interim final rule on seat belt warning systems: unified compliance date 2028-09-01; clarifications to front visual warning, audible-warning trigger, occupant-detection size and rear change-of-status deactivation

General Safety Regulation adopted: safety-belt reminders per UN R16 (Annex II A6) required for M1, M2, M3, N1, N2, N3 (all front and M1/N1 rear seats per R16 07 series); R14/R16/R17/R145/R129 listed compulsory

unmatched_B.what_changed: Dipped-beam headlamps may switch ON/OFF automatically on other factors (time of day, location, rain, fog); when position lamps are switched ON with DRL, at least the rear position lamps shall be ON; tell-tale exemption for that mode

01 series: performance-based rewrite; new adaptive driving-beam class for L3 vehicles and Driver Assistance Projection as part of ADB/passing beam (with R48/R53 parallel amendments); approvals to earlier series first issued after 2026-09-01 need not be accepted
First issue: test procedures, performance requirements and design guidelines for adaptive driving beam and associated equipment (catalogue scope only)
Revision, retitled 'Adaptive Driving Beam System': test procedures, performance requirements and design guidelines for ADB and associated equipment (catalogue scope only)
Supplement 3 to 10 series: vehicles of category X (no driver) and ADS: retractor-related warning that would go to the driver is, while an ADSF-2 is active, transmitted as a logic signal to the ADS

Occupant protection FMVSSs amended for ADS-equipped vehicles without manual controls: in FMVSS 208 the left front seat becomes a passenger seat, advanced air-bag (suppression) requirements apply to each front outboard passenger seat, and a separate air-bag suppression telltale is required for each front outboard passenger seat
